notes.title: Busy Few Weeks
notes.notes:
It has been a full month sine Meiro Master was released. 

The community have been absolutely perfect and have offered so much support and feedback.

Feedback is so vital to us to make sure that improvements are made. Over the last couple of weeks, the following patch updates have been made to make improvements to gameplay:
[list]
[*] Brand new dialogue graphics- it was said that the graphics for the dialogue system was basic. Now they are a brand new design with more style and colour.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Updates to the design of levels- some of the Meiro maze levels were plain with basic colours. Now these levels have been updated to match the overall style of Meiro master.
[/list]
[list]
[*] More animals added- you wanted more animals so now you have more animals to interact with.
[/list]

Again the success of Meiro Master would not be possible without our fantastic fans. Thank you and keep an eye on further patch updates because we have many more planned!!

notes.title: Meiro Mazes explained
notes.notes:
The first Meiro Maze was built by a long-forgotten tribe. Since that time, Meiro Mazes now dominate the most elite sports.

They are uniquely designed to test your strength, logic and all-round skills. Each city in Meiro Master has a region Meiro badge held by the region champion. Go to each city and defeat the region Meiro champions to collect the badges.

In order to compete against Meiro Master Donte, you must first collect the five region Meiro badges. The task of completing the Meiro trials and collecting the badges will be difficult. You must practice and keep on improving if you have any chance of collecting the region Meiro badges and going on to defeat Meiro Master Donte.

notes.title: Meet the Hero
notes.notes:
Russell is a Midori City native, who has just turned 18 (the age required to collect the regional Meiro badges).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049201/e7fdf31d48f10e98ca2e15e7300fcd0514122088.jpg[/img]

Ever since he could remember, Russell has watched the Meiro games obsessively. He loves the excitement and the prestige of collecting the region Meiro badges and then challenging Meiro Master Donte.

As his love for the Meiro games continued growing up, he decided that he wanted to become the Meiro Master, one day. He then found Master Blade, the former Meiro Master and became his apprentice. Ever since he has been training, working hard and getting ready for the challenge of collecting the region Meiro badges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049201/c80550469eeff4119ca55452a0a9d7ac63768950.jpg[/img]

Now the time has come to put the training to use and start collecting the region Meiro badges by beating the region Meiro champions. Join Russell on a very exciting journey of determination, excitement and fun filled levels. Each city you encounter has many different levels to help you on your quest of becoming the Meiro Master.

It will be down to you to help Russell achieve the status of Meiro Master.

notes.title: Level design- Part One
notes.notes:
Ever wondered what designing a level in a game looks like?

We have recorded the process on Unity from the point of where we start designing. Well before the level design is implemented on Unity, we use good old fashioned pen and paper to map the level.

This is usually a rough sketch on layout and basic look. In this level, it will feature two islands that are surrounded by beautiful oceans and mountains. Using Unity Terrain features, we create the land first. The mountains are then sculpted. We have opted for the mountains to be on the very edge of the level, so to the player they will be in the distance.

Game level design is never straight forward or absolute. Many changes are constantly happening in the background to ensure the level is fluid and looks beautiful.

[previewyoutube=9LOQOXQroiI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Twilight Forest
notes.notes:
While exploring Midori City, Russell talks to Kelly. Kelly tells you that she has somewhere to show Russell.

She then leads to Twilight Forest. It's a secret place, home to many deer. You have been led here because Master Blade, also a deer, told the chief that Russell has what it takes to become the Meiro Master.

Knowing that Master Blade believes in Russell, Chief Tamfa invites Russell to Twilight Forest to give his blessings and offer his advice.

notes.title: Midori City Revamp
notes.notes:
The next step of the process for MIdori City was to make it more immersive for the player. The city itself was finished in terms of the buildings and layout but it didn't feature many characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049201/c80550469eeff4119ca55452a0a9d7ac63768950.jpg[/img]

Now while walking in the streets of Midori City, you will encounter lots of different characters. Some you will be able to interact with and some are just minding their own business and enjoying the sunshine.

[previewyoutube=UsLowDGPG5E;full][/previewyoutube]

Midori City is the first city you will explore while playing Meiro Master. It is the home of Russell, your character. As it is your birth place, the first badge to collect is the Midori City Meiro badge, currently held by Xavier. Before competing against Xavier, you must enter the Meiro trials in Midori City and beat the other competitors.

notes.title: Zielona Village
notes.notes:
While exploring MIdori City, a quest will lead you to discover Queen Serpelope. Curious,  you find out the queen is from a place called Zielona Village. They have a problem in Zielona, their talisman has been stolen and they need help to retrieve it.

You're then exported to Zielona Village. A beautiful, lovely village that is residents to the cutest bunnies (personally my favourite place)! While this is not the biggest place, it's full of bunnies and stunning houses, as well as a Meiro maze.

You discover from King Quasa that the talisman is at the finish of the Meiro maze. They have already asked Meiro Master Donte to help but he declined. This means it is up to you to use your skills to nagivate the Meiro maze and get the talisman back.

You may also discover a hidden character at the top.

notes.title: Final Test
notes.notes:
While exploring Midori City you will come in to contact with Master Blade. Master Blade is your mentor, your trainer and former Meiro Master before being beaten by current Meiro Master Donte.

The Midori City region trials are upcoming. you prove to Master Blade and yourself, he has one last test for Russell. You will be exported to a Meiro test site.

Use your skills to traverse the obstacles and show beyond doubt that Russell is ready to compete on the professional stage.

notes.title: Brand New Level!
notes.notes:
When you talk to your brother Oliver in Midori City, he tells you that he has discovered some old ruins. Go and explore this beautiful new level.

It is a lovely forest scene, littered with colourful flowers and trees. Walk around and discover the old ruins and find yourself immersed in a fantasy forest..

Have a walk to the lakeside and just enjoy the peaceful waterfall and slow sinds moving the plants and flowers. 

Keep exploring and find Master Mucitar. Nobody has seen him for over 250 years but his status of being the very first Meiro Master still remains legend.
